== Objectives ==
Slay 5 Stormreaver Outrunner, 10 Stormreaver Ravager, 5 Stormreaver Drone, 5 Stormreaver Raider and return to Kilrogg Deadeye in Stormbreaker Point.
* [[Stormreaver Outrunner]] slain (5)
* [[Stormreaver Ravager]] slain (10)
* [[Stormreaver Drone]] slain (5)
* [[Stormreaver Raider]] slain (5)

== Description ==
Since I have regained my freedom, I have come to think about many things. Many questions have riddled my mind into labyrinths I have struggled to overcome. It was for that reason alone I chose to step aside for some time. However, I did not expect to be so easily forgotten. Mere thoughts.

In my short-lived hermit life, I was once or twice challenged to duel the notion of evilness. Are we born evil—or do we become so later on, due to circumstances? The conclusion I came to was quite simple: we all bear a seed of evil at the root of our own being, but it is by choice whether it grows or not.

Which brings us to your next task. If you believe my words earlier to be nothing but a bore, hear me now. Havoc is what they know, so havoc is what you will give. Go beyond Breezehaven, push closer to the castle—your targets await. You are not a killer—you are the consequence of their actions, coming to take its due.

==Rewards==
You will receive:
* 2800 XP

== Progress ==
How thin the line between arrogance and confidence can be.

== Completion ==
Today, you have been the consequence of others. One day, your own will find you.
